name: Boiler feedwater pretreatment
description: Remove suspended solids, chlorine/oxidants, scale-forming calcium/magnesium hardness and alkalinity from raw/make-up water before it reaches the boiler, reducing scale, foaming, carryover and chemical demand. External (pre-boiler) treatment is preferred where possible; conditioning is only a supplement.

specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco description of resin beads in packed-bed GRP pressure vessel

specifications.metric: TDS reduction by sodium base exchange
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: no reduction in TDS and no change in pH; only exchange of scale-forming for non-scale-forming salts

specifications.metric: Condensate return threshold for successful softener use in high alkaline hardness areas
Condensate return below which more sophisticated ion exchange / dealkalisation is preferable
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco, shell boiler plant selection
CEA/ICOM BG04 §2.14: sodium hydroxide solution added after degassing to raise pH to at least 8.5

specifications.metric: Feed water total hardness — shell boiler
specifications.basis: CEA BG04 Table 2, recommended water characteristics for shell or coil boilers up to 32 bar g

specifications.metric: Feed water pH at 25 °C — shell boiler / coil boiler
specifications.basis: CEA BG04 Table 2; note 1: with copper alloys in feed system shell-boiler value should not exceed pH 9.2

specifications.metric: Feed water alkalinity threshold for CO2 carryover
specifications.basis: CEA BG04 Table 2 note 5: >=25 ppm alkalinity results in about 10 ppm CO2 in the steam; dealkalisation or RO then recommended

specifications.metric: Thermal conductivity of calcium carbonate scale
specifications.basis: CEA BG04 Table 1, typical boiler scales (6.0–18.0 Btu in/h ft2 °F)

specifications.metric: Steam velocity in well-designed steam system
specifications.basis: CEA BG04 §1.3 note: 25 m/s = 90 kph and up to 40 m/s = 145 kph; above 40 m/s deemed bad practice
